name: NULL BOUT: Bare-BCI Underground Combat League
description: A newer and more disturbing evolution of underground combat sport, NULL BOUT matches pair fighters with minimal physical augmentation but high-grade BCI rigs, competing in low-light arenas where the primary combat language is neural — fighters read each other's micro-movements through BCI-enhanced perception, respond at machine-assisted speeds, and the physical violence is precise and catastrophic rather than overwhelming. Venues rotate through abandoned signal infrastructure in the deep Shelf; entry requires a working BCI and a physical Quanta ante. The founding collective — known only as the Null Board — has never been publicly identified.
story_hooks: A Tier 3 BCI technician who follows the NULL BOUT feed for sport discovers that one of the fighters is a former colleague who disappeared eighteen months ago after a corporate restructuring.

A district enforcer tasked with shutting down NULL BOUT realizes that the Null Board's encrypted communications infrastructure is more sophisticated than anything she's seen outside of corponation networks.

A NULL BOUT fighter who has won eleven consecutive bouts begins experiencing what she believes are fragments of her opponents' memories bleeding into her own neural architecture — and she hasn't told anyone.
